source: NOAA GEFS v12 atmos 0.5-degree member products (pgrb2a + pgrb2b, noaa-gefs-pds)
time_policy: decoded at every valid time and required invariant
member_policy: one member per preparation: the member axis is carried in every message's PDT (perturbationNumber / typeOfEnsembleForecast) and the frame assembler refuses inputs that mix members; which members exist and how their bytes verify is the packaged rw-wps.members.v1 grammar consumed by gpuwm-member-prep
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
